title: Uniform measured 2-CNF variable-deletion SAT under a polynomial branch budget
claims: ExactPolynomialBudgetTwoSATBackdoor checks P membership for canonical deletion-backdoor domain recognition and its satisfiable subset when some deletion depth k satisfies 6^k ≤ q(input length)+1.
MeasuredRankedBackdoorWalk proves that a successful rank below a unary budget exists exactly when the structural CNF has a feasible deletion backdoor and the residual CNF is satisfiable.
PolynomialBudgetTwoSATBackdoorSearch constructs a satisfying sparse assignment with encoded length at most that of the original formula.
